_doc: LANCE-19 batch 4: Minelayer (RGriffin65), tracked; seven wheels a side.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 4, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in minelayer_veh.json). Moving parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (minelayer_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_*`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above the per-part budget (no Blender collapse on shell soup). TRACKED: belts `track_l`/`track_r` (faces within 110 mm of the closed belt path round the seven wheels a side; strip 2 x 185 mm). The kit has a hexagonal tower on the deck and a rear plough arm, both static (the original is a low flat tracked hull with a tower and a plough; the rig has no part for them).
